purpose: Finite normal-completion diagnostic distance to QPS +10% and P99 -20%; not final release acceptance
topology: hosted ubuntu24.04; one process containing loopback TCP client and server; one worker; same two allowed logical CPUs selected on distinct guest-reported (socket,core)
affinity: smallest allowed online CPU, then smallest allowed online CPU on a different guest (socket,core); stop if mapping unavailable
isolationClaim: None; retain guest core/socket/SMT and cgroup observations; no physical-core isolation claim
quantile: nearest rank ceil(n*p), exact integer rational rank, no floating-point percentile rank
pairOrder: odd pair official then dev; even pair dev then official; scenarios rotated by pair index
failurePolicy: retain every planned slot and all raw failures; no replacement, exclusion, retry, adaptive stop or claim from incomplete evidence
releaseBoundary: Exact candidate8ae9ee36 main source and tree versus official2.0.3 packages. Four representative normal-completion cells only; neither final release acceptance nor full functional parity.
interopBoundary: No cross-major interoperability gate; each arm uses same-version client/server and its own Generator
aggregation: Per cell median of six paired dev/official QPS ratios and separately six paired P99 ratios. Retain all six ratios and exact rational metrics. No operation pooling, no best round, no cross-cell global pass. All4 cells mandatory; any failed/missing input blocks target observations.
coldPolicy: Four dedicated candidate-only strict-cleanup processes and eight symmetric normal-validate processes must pass before timing. Each of 48 fresh normal-measure processes repeats normal-only controls; no failure/cancellation/early-exit probes in either arm timed process.

knownNegative.result: Historical untimed static-none cleanup failure; CTS and dynamic controls passed. Reference only; no re-execution, no performance claim, no claim lost O203N1 passed.

evidencePolicy: User-authorized temporary CI artifact retained for 3 days: raw per-process ticks, rounds, exact process-wide allocation counters, process order, binary/package/runtime provenance, build logs and all failures. Never commit evidence or create an evidence branch. Ordinary CI logs contain allowlisted per-round and per-cell metrics, not raw tick vectors.

dependencyPolicy.buildClosure: Four identical private10.0.12 dependency DLLs copied to both prepared snapshots; these are build closure, not asserted runtime load origins.
dependencyPolicy.executionClosure: Exactly four pinned Microsoft dependency identities from private Microsoft.AspNetCore.App10.0.14, common to both arms; all product and fixture assemblies remain own-arm only.
dependencyPolicy.remainingFrameworkClosure: Every other loaded non-dynamic assembly must match canonical path and SHA256 derived independently from the two fixed SHA512-verified private runtime14 archives; unknown, inserted or symlinked DLLs rejected. Collection and hashing occur outside all timing windows.

allocationMetric: Process-wide GC.GetTotalAllocatedBytes(true) end minus start divided by completed stream operations; counters enclose the unchanged timing window, include both loopback client/server and measurement orchestration, and exclude warmup, preallocated tick arrays, drain/shutdown and serialization. No per-item or thread-local attribution; descriptive only, no allocation target.
